# Wiktionary

> > A free multilingual dictionary providing definitions, pronunciations, etymologies, and grammatical information for words and phrases across all languages.

Wiktionary is a collaborative project offering comprehensive lexicographic content including verb conjugations, pronunciation guides using the International Phonetic Alphabet, alternative forms, and phrasebook entries. It covers English varieties like General American and Received Pronunciation, as well as Latin and other world languages.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary entries
- Verb forms and conjugations
- Past tense and past participle
- Pronunciation (IPA)
- English grammar
- General American English
- Received Pronunciation
- Latin language
- Alternative forms
- Uncountable nouns
- Phrasebook expressions
- Multiword terms
- Etymology
- International Phonetic Alphabet

## English Vocabulary

- [street credibility](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/street_credibility): Dictionary entry for 'street credibility' - English uncountable noun
- [started](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/started): Dictionary entry for 'started' - past tense verb form with pronunciation
- [modded](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/modded): Dictionary entry for 'modded' - past tense/participle verb form
- [rashguard](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/rashguard): Dictionary entry for 'rashguard' - water sports athletic wear term

## Latin Language

- [debere](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/debere): Latin verb conjugation entry for 'debere' with inflection details

## Phrasebook and Expressions

- [çok teşekkür ederim](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/çok_teşekkür_ederim): Turkish phrasebook entry for gratitude expression 'thank you very much'
